title: The Teleporter goes back to its last spot
description: The player teleports straight up and falls back. He fires a shotgun, swaps it for the teleporter and uses it facing left, before the shotgun's wait is over: it takes him straight up again, to the spot its last use picked. Used once the wait is over, it takes him five blocks left.
